verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MUKAMA twagala,
Ekifo mw'obeera,
Kye kitusanyusa
Okukijjukira.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ye nnyumba yo ddala
Mwe tukumgaanira,
Otusembeze gy'oli
Abazze-okusaba

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Gye babatiriza
Abava mu kibi;
Wonna watukuvu,
Kye kifo-ekirungi.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
We wali-emmeeza yo,
Gye tulira naawe
N'owa-abakwagala
Emmere y'obulamu.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Bwe batubuulira
Ebyawandiikibwa;
Ennaku ziggwaawo,
Tubeera n'essanyu.

verse.name: v7
verse.lines:
Otuwe-ekisa kyo
Okukwagala mu nsi,
Era ne mu ggulu
Okukusuutanga
